cards.title: Anthropic Plans IPO, Sets Valuation Range
cards.body: The AI company is expected to set its valuation range this week, according to Wall Street Journal reporting. Anthropic is moving forward with its initial public offering plans.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Pulls Out of Major Events
cards.body: Jensen Huang withdrew from both ElevenLabs Summit and an Anthropic event amid ongoing controversy. The pullouts come as Nvidia's board investigates Huang's relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.

cards.title: Anthropic Releases Mythos and Fable Models
cards.body: The new models show improvements in coding, reasoning, vision, and user communication. Anthropic continues advancing its model capabilities amid broader industry developments.

cards.title: Meta Launches Muse Ember Lightweight Model
cards.body: Muse Ember costs just 10 cents per million input tokens, significantly cheaper than competitors like Haiku and Luna. The lightweight model enables cost-effective agent execution.

cards.title: Anthropic Purchases $3.4B in Gas Turbines
cards.body: Anthropic bought billions of dollars' worth of natural gas turbines to power AI operations. The major infrastructure investment signals the company's commitment to energy-intensive AI development.

cards.title: Medium Launches TK AI Writing Assistant App
cards.body: The new app brings AI assistance directly into the writing process for users. Medium embraces AI-assisted writing despite ongoing industry controversy.

cards.title: Automattic Debuts Spacefast App Platform
cards.body: Automattic launched Spacefast to deploy vibe-coding apps amid internet evolution. The platform aims to compete with services like Lovable.

cards.title: Nvidia Board Investigates CEO Jensen Huang
cards.body: Nvidia's board opened a formal investigation into Huang's relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. Huang admitted to an affair in a memo to the company.

cards.title: Short Seller Flagged Huang Ties Six Months Ago
cards.body: Culper Research questioned Jensen Huang's unusually close relationship with a Chinese executive six months before the scandal erupted. The early warning preceded Nvidia's investigation by months.

cards.title: Lawsuits Loom for Nvidia Over CEO Scandal
cards.body: Nvidia's stock dropped over 4% following the board investigation announcement. Securities law experts warn the company's earlier claims that the relationship was 'normal' could prove costly.

cards.title: Huang's Job Security Estimated at 50-50
cards.body: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld estimates roughly a coin flip on whether Jensen Huang remains CEO. The expert assessment reflects uncertainty surrounding the investigation's outcome.

cards.title: Huang Scandal Threatens Nvidia's China Strategy
cards.body: The alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy complicates Nvidia's lobbying efforts for chip export flexibility. The controversy threatens the company's access to China's AI market.

cards.title: Chinese MSS Recruited Female Tech Exec as Spy
cards.body: A US intelligence memo reportedly claimed China's Ministry of State Security recruited a female technology executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO. The alleged recruitment occurred months before the scandal became public.

cards.title: OpenAI Raises Additional $11 Billion Funding
cards.body: OpenAI secured an extra $11 billion as part of an ongoing funding round expected to close soon. The investment values the company at $1.25 trillion.

cards.title: Meta Introduces Spaces for Agent Collaboration
cards.body: Spaces provides a new way to interact with and collaborate through Meta's Muse agents. The feature continues expanding Muse agent capabilities and integrations.

cards.title: Hundreds of Artex Hacking Tools Exposed Online
cards.body: Security researchers discovered hundreds of servers hosting penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet. Anyone could access the hacking tool without authorization.

cards.title: Crusoe Sells Wyoming Data Center to Google
cards.body: Crusoe sold its troubled Wyoming data center project to Google. The deal highlights the significant challenges of developing massive AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Big Tech Shifts Strategy After Midterms
cards.body: After years cultivating White House relationships, Big Tech now courts Democratic allies. The industry faces uncertainty from state and local actions plus market pressures.

cards.title: PR Firm Hired to Handle Huang Controversy
cards.body: A PR firm with high-profile scandal experience was enlisted by Nvidia a year ago. The firm was hired shortly after reports of Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang.

cards.title: Tech Industry Faces Uncertain Regulatory Future
cards.body: Midterm election results create uncertainty for tech companies' policy priorities. Both data center expansion and AI regulation now face shifting political dynamics.

cards.title: Data Center Backlash Is Really About Electricity
cards.body: As AI infrastructure expands across Virginia's Data Center Alley, voter concerns focus on energy consumption rather than technology itself. The debate highlights tensions between AI advancement and resource sustainability.

cards.title: AI Regulator Scott Wiener Enters Congress
cards.body: California state senator Scott Wiener, known for AI-risk legislation, won Nancy Pelosi's San Francisco House seat. He's positioned to shape federal artificial intelligence policy.

cards.title: Climate Case for AI Remains Unproven
cards.body: At the UN climate conference, experts question whether AI's environmental benefits justify its energy demands. The narrative supporting AI as a climate solution lacks solid evidence.

cards.title: AI Accelerates Innovation in Specialty Chemicals
cards.body: Companies leverage AI, cloud computing, and advanced modeling to speed product development in chemicals manufacturing. The main challenge is connecting new technologies with reliable data and real-world constraints.

cards.title: Humanoid Robot Cleaning Service Launches
cards.body: A new AI-powered humanoid robot cleaning service debuted in San Francisco. Early users describe the experience as glimpsing the future of domestic automation.

cards.title: Texas AI Data Center Boom May Stall
cards.body: Texas became the fastest-growing US data center market for AI infrastructure, but political shifts could jeopardize that position. Recent election results may impact Big Tech's expansion plans.

cards.title: Sam Altman Parody Teaches Memory Management
cards.body: A humorous parody involving OpenAI's CEO offers unexpected lessons about computer memory principles. The post went viral for its technical wit.

cards.title: Claude Code Accidentally Exposes Secrets
cards.body: Anthropic's Claude Code is inadvertently leaking sensitive information across GitHub repositories. The vulnerability raises concerns about AI tool security and developer practices.
